The NHANES 2001-2002 gait-speed example

gait_data.Rd

Gait speed (m/s, timed 20-ft walk, 6.096 m / walk time) and seven lower-body mobility items of the physical functioning questionnaire, scored 0 = no difficulty, 1 = some, 2 = much, 3 = unable (refused and don't know missing), for persons aged 60+ with a valid walk time and at least one item answered (n = 1,426). Built from the public-use files MSX_B, PFQ_B and DEMO_B by `inst/scripts/gait_data.R` and shipped as [pf_gait]. Analyses are unweighted.

Usage

gait_data(exclude_aids = FALSE, skip_unable = FALSE, file = NULL)

Arguments

exclude_aids

drop walking-aid users

skip_unable

score the skipped walking items as unable

file

path to an analysis CSV file with the columns of [pf_gait]; `NULL` (default) uses the package data set [pf_gait]

Value

list(dat, Y, speed, n, tag, exclude_aids, skip_unable, n_skip_recoded); `tag` is "", "_noaids" or "_skipunable"

Details

Items C1 (walking a quarter mile) and C2 (walking up 10 steps) are not asked of people who need special equipment to walk (PFQ055 = 1, 103 people) and are missing for them. Two sensitivity variants are available: `exclude_aids = TRUE` drops the 161 walking-aid users (needs equipment, a device used in the walk test, or could not walk unassisted); `skip_unable = TRUE` scores the skipped C1 and C2 as 3 = unable.
